ABOUT US

With the trust of our customers and the expertise of our engineers , MKRD provides top-notch services in all areas of mould design that includes : hot nozzles; hot runner systems (single point and multi-drop); unscrewing tools; side cores; up & away; two stage ejection; hydraulic core pulling and more. We offer CAD drawing and design services , using the latest 3D modelling and drawing techniques , which are specifically aimed at the Plastic Injection Mould sector of manufacturing.
